verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a built-in AI assistant in the Customer Area that answers natural-language queries over fraud data, drafts rules, or summarizes investigations. The MCP server gives natural-language access only through the user's own external LLM client. That is a different capability and an adjacent building block, so it earns no credit. The ML risk scoring is transaction evaluation, not an analyst-facing assistant.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, the product ships its own AI assistant — natural-language queries over my fraud data, drafted rules, investigation summaries — built into the console
